idea-plugin.name: Qoder CLI Launcher
idea-plugin.description:
Qoder CLI Launcher adds a toolbar button that opens a terminal tab named "Qoder CLI" in the current file's directory and runs the Qoder CLI (qodercli). After the CLI exits, the tab drops back to an interactive shell so it stays open for further use. Works on macOS, Linux and Windows.

You can also right-click a file in the editor or the Project view and open the 问 Qoder CLI submenu to pick a task — 解释 (explain), 审查 (review), 写测试 (write tests), 重构 (refactor), 补文档 (add docs), 优化 (optimize), or 自定义… (a free-form question). The chosen file (or selected snippet) is attached as context and the CLI opens in interactive mode, ready for follow-up questions. A 继续当前会话 ("continue current session") toggle controls whether tasks continue in the existing terminal session or always start a new one. The menu is in Chinese, matching the Qoder CLI itself.

Where the IDE knows something a terminal agent cannot, the plugin hands it over. 修报错 (fix the problems) appears in that same submenu whenever the current file or selection carries errors or warnings, and passes the list along. 用 Qoder CLI 解释报错 sends the selected output of a Run / Debug console — or its tail — for diagnosis. 让 Qoder CLI review 未提交的改动 (Tools menu, or the Local Changes view) names the files you have touched and lets the CLI run git diff itself.

Prerequisites
  • The Qoder CLI (qodercli) must be installed and available on your PATH (the plugin only launches it, it does not bundle it).
  • An IntelliJ-based IDE with the bundled Terminal plugin enabled.
  • IDE version 2025.1 (build 251) or newer (the terminal API this plugin relies on is not available in earlier builds).

This is an independent helper that launches the separately installed Qoder CLI.
Qoder CLI Launcher 会在工具栏添加一个按钮：在当前文件所在目录打开一个名为 “Qoder CLI” 的终端标签页并运行 Qoder CLI（qodercli）。命令结束后会回落到 交互式 shell，标签页保持打开以便继续使用。支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。

你还可以在编辑器或项目视图中右键某个文件，打开 问 Qoder CLI 子菜单挑选任务 — 解释、审查、写测试、重构、补文档、优化，或“自定义…”自由提问。选中的文件（或选中的代码片段） 会作为上下文附件带入，CLI 以交互模式打开，便于继续追问。菜单里的“继续当前会话”开关用于控制 任务是在已有终端会话里接着问，还是每次都新开一个会话。每个任务都是独立的 action，可以在 Find Action 里搜到，也可以在 Keymap 里绑定快捷键。

凡是只有 IDE 才知道的信息，插件都会替你交给 CLI：当前文件（或选区）里有 error / warning 时， 子菜单里会多出 修报错，把问题清单一并带上；在运行 / 调试控制台里右键可用 用 Qoder CLI 解释报错，把选中的输出（或末尾若干行）交给 CLI 定位根因； 让 Qoder CLI review 未提交的改动（Tools 菜单或 Local Changes 面板）会点名你改过的文件， 具体 diff 由 CLI 自己执行 git diff 获取。

使用前提
  • 已安装 Qoder CLI（qodercli），且其在系统 PATH 中可直接调用 （本插件只负责启动，不内置 CLI 本体）。
  • 基于 IntelliJ 的 IDE，并已启用内置的 Terminal 插件。
  • IDE 版本为 2025.1（build 251） 或更高（本插件依赖的终端 API 在更早版本中不存在）。

本插件是一个独立的辅助工具，用于启动你单独安装好的 Qoder CLI。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0
  • 问 Qoder CLI context-menu submenu (editor & Project view) with preset tasks — 解释, 审查, 写测试, 重构, 补文档, 优化 — plus 自定义… for a free-form question. The file or selected snippet is attached as context and the CLI opens in interactive mode. A 继续当前会话 toggle decides whether a task continues in the running session or starts a fresh one. Every entry is a normal action, so it can be found in Find Action and bound to a shortcut.
  • 修报错: the same submenu offers a "fix the problems" entry whenever the IDE reports errors or warnings in the current file (or selection), and sends that list to the CLI. It stays hidden when the file is clean.
  • 用 Qoder CLI 解释报错: right-click inside a Run or Debug console to send the selected output — or the tail of it — to the CLI for diagnosis. The text is attached as a file and the referenced source locations are named in the prompt.
  • 让 Qoder CLI review 未提交的改动: from the Tools menu or the Local Changes view, ask the CLI to review your working copy. It runs git diff itself, so the whole diff never has to be pasted anywhere.
新增 问 Qoder CLI 右键子菜单（编辑器与项目视图），内置任务：解释、审查、写测试、重构、补文档、 优化，另有“自定义…”，以及“继续当前会话”开关；文件或选中代码会作为上下文附件带入，CLI 以交互模式打开。 每个任务都是独立 action，可在 Find Action 搜索、在 Keymap 绑定快捷键。
当 IDE 在当前文件（或选区）里报出 error / warning 时，子菜单里会多出“修报错”，把问题清单一并交给 CLI； 文件没问题时该项自动隐藏。
在运行 / 调试控制台里右键可用“用 Qoder CLI 解释报错”，把选中的输出（或末尾若干行）作为附件交给 CLI 定位根因，提示语里会点名涉及的源码位置。
在 Tools 菜单或 Local Changes 面板可以让 CLI review 未提交的改动，具体内容由它自己执行 git diff 获取，无需把 diff 粘来粘去。

1.0.0
  • Initial release: one-click launch of the Qoder CLI in the IDE's embedded terminal, cross-platform (macOS / Linux / Windows).
首个版本：一键在 IDE 内置终端启动 Qoder CLI，支持 macOS / Linux / Windows。
